title: The shop between runs
summary: R.E.P.O. is not only the levels: the game defines a shopkeeper, a shop manager, upgrade stands and cosmetic machines, which is where your takings turn into a stronger crew.
body: Between runs the game gives you a shop to spend in, with someone keeping it and its own cost display rather than a bare menu.
Upgrades are bought at a stand and keep their own information, so an upgrade is a thing in the world rather than a checkbox you tick.
Cosmetics have their own machine, so changing how the crew looks is a separate decision from getting stronger.

What you have bought is accounted for in one place. An item manager keeps the purchased items, the power crystals spent on them, what has been spawned into the world, the local player's inventory and the lights that go with the item icons, which is why the shop can show you what you own.
What this entry does not tell you: prices, how many upgrades exist or what each one changes. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: The game has a shopkeeper and a shop manager for the between-run shop.
Shop costs are shown by the game rather than inferred.
Upgrades are bought at a stand and carry their own information.
Cosmetics come from a separate machine.
An item manager keeps what has been purchased, the power crystals, what has been spawned, the local player's inventory and lights for the item icons.
